definitions.explanation: Happening or doing something regularly but not constantly; from time to time.

examples.japanese: ちょくちょく{会|あ}います。
この{店|みせ}にはちょくちょく{来|き}ます。
examples.english: I come to this shop frequently.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}ちょくちょく{電話|でんわ}がかかってくる。
examples.english: Lately I've been getting calls quite often.

notes:
ちょくちょく means "fairly often" or "from time to time" — more frequent than {時々|ときどき} but less constant than いつも.

FREQUENCY SCALE (approximate):
- いつも: always
- よく: often
- ちょくちょく: fairly often (casual)
- {時々|ときどき}: sometimes
- たまに: occasionally
- めったに～ない: rarely

SIMILAR ADVERBS:
- よく: often (neutral register, broader usage)
- {度々|たびたび}: frequently (more formal)
- しばしば: often (literary/written)
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に: frequently (formal)

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Not appropriate for formal writing or speeches. Use {頻繁|ひんぱん}に or {度々|たびたび} in formal contexts.
